application_hash_method: Sorted production application paths: SHA256 of path + space + file SHA256 + newline. This aggregate describes the final frontend/backend pair only; earlier frames keep their verified runtime epoch and do not inherit it.

fixture.identities: Ordinary initiator202, designer/observer204, candidates207/208/209 and additional approver211. No superadmin approval.

api_verification.limitation: Supplementary API cases use ABSOLUTE_UNIT. They did not detect the later reproduced missing trusted initiator for ordinary PARENT startup; the fixed backend and UI journeys verify that separately.

ui_verification.journal: All four locales PASS; every submitted business operation COMMITTED, Chinese12 operations and others11 because of the retained draft repair.
ui_verification.earlier_zh_run: 007 completed the Chinese UI journey;008 reconciled its committed state read-only. English/Japanese/Korean executed their new journeys in008.
ui_verification.journey: Create and design ALL; save, validate, publish1; ordinary API start, UI first vote; publish ANY2 while ALL1 remains active; ANY one vote ends and skips two tasks; old ALL1 receives its remaining two actual votes.
ui_verification.earlier_failures: Runs001-006 retained privately. They include selection/label test errors, capitalized listener serialization and the real missing-trusted-initiator startup failure. Live API and exact engine counts reconciled unknown outcomes before any retry.

code_verification.backend: Full20-project Maven reactor clean install PASS,15m30s; new3 trusted-start identity boundary regressions PASS.
code_verification.frontend: 21 unit tests PASS/0 skipped; production build, lint and E2E typecheck PASS. XML roundtrip checks actual Flowable tags, typed elements and MI attributes.
